items.headline: Michigan: El-Sayed pehle Muslim Senator bane
items.detail: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed ne Republican Mike Rogers ko harakar Michigan ki Senate seat jeeti; ve Senate mein chune gaye pehle Muslim hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Jeffries pehle Black Speaker banne ki ore
items.detail: Democrats ki House jeet se Hakeem Jeffries America ke pehle Black Speaker banne ki line mein hain; naya House January mein shapath lega.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — House aur Speaker.

items.headline: Trump: Israel ko madad saal ant tak band
items.detail: Trump ne Fox News ko kaha America saal ke ant tak Israel ko $4 billion salana sainya madad dena band karega; zaroorat par madad jaari rahegi aur hathiyar bikri chalti rahegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Israel sambandh: International exams ke liye — sainya sahayata samjhauta.

items.headline: South Africa: ANC ki pariksha, matdan jaari
items.detail: 29.2 million matdata sthaniya chunav mein matdan kar rahe hain; ANC ke samarthan 40% se neeche jaane ka anuman hai, natije Ravivar ko aayenge.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Africa: International exams ke liye — sthaniya chunav aur ANC.

items.headline: Florida: Learjet ke tukde kilometre door mile
items.detail: NTSB ne kaha Learjet ka left elevator 2 se 6 kilometre door mila, isse pata chalta hai viman girne se pehle toot raha tha; nau log mare gaye, karan abhi tay nahi.

items.headline: Brussels: Ukraine suraksha par baatchit shuru
items.detail: Ukraine, America, Europe aur NATO ke pratinidhi 4-5 November ko suraksha guarantee aur punarnirman par baatchit karenge; Abu Dhabi vaarta se pehle ki taiyari hai.

items.headline: Iowa: Turek ne Hinson ko haraya
items.detail: Democrat Josh Turek ne Republican Ashley Hinson ko harakar Iowa ki Senate seat palti; ve 2008 ke baad Iowa se Senate jeetne wale pehle Democrat hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Ohio: Brown Senate mein wapas aaye
items.detail: Democrat Sherrod Brown ne Republican Jon Husted ko harakar Ohio ki Senate seat palti; yah vishesh chunav JD Vance ke uprashtrapati banne se khaali hui seat ke liye tha.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav; vishesh chunav.

items.headline: Texas: Talarico ne Paxton ko haraya
items.detail: Democrat James Talarico ne Republican Ken Paxton ko harakar Texas ki Senate seat palti; ve 1988 ke baad Texas se Senate jeetne wale pehle Democrat hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Maine: Jackson ne Collins ko haraya
items.detail: Democrat Troy Jackson ne paanch baar chuni gayi Senator Susan Collins ko harakar Maine ki seat palti; Collins 1996 se Senator thi aur unhone haar maan li.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Texas: Hinojosa ne Abbott ko haraya
items.detail: Democrat Gina Hinojosa ne Governor Greg Abbott ko harakar Texas ki pehli Latina governor banne ka itihas racha; ve 1990 ke baad pehli Democrat governor hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: Ohio: Acton pehli mahila governor bani
items.detail: Democrat Amy Acton ne Vivek Ramaswamy ko harakar Ohio ki pehli chuni gayi mahila governor banne ka itihas racha; ve 20 saal mein pehli Democrat governor hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: Kansas: Hamilton 1932 ke baad pehle Democrat
items.detail: Democrat Adam Hamilton ne Senator Roger Marshall ko harakar 1932 ke baad Kansas se Senate jeetne wale pehle Democrat ban gaye.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Spain: Mantri Puente ne istifa diya
items.detail: Parivahan Mantri Oscar Puente ne 69 logon ki jaan lene wale train hadse ke chhah din baad istifa de diya; saal mein yah doosra bada rail hadsa tha.
items.exam_angle: Rail suraksha aur jawabdehi: International exams ke liye — Spain mein mantri ka istifa.

items.headline: America: Democrats ne Senate bhi jeeta
items.detail: Democrats ne Senate par niyantran le liya; Texas, Ohio aur Kansas mein jeet ke saath chaar seat ki zaroorat poori hui.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: North Korea: Samudra ki ore prakshepan
items.detail: Dakshin Korea ki sena ne kaha North Korea ne poorvi tat ke paas samudra ki ore ek agyaat prakshepan kiya; yah Kim Yo Jong ke baatchit se inkar ke kuch ghante baad hua.

items.headline: Ukraine: Sahayata kendra par hamla, 33 mare
items.detail: Komyshuvakha mein sahayata baantne wale school par hamle mein kam se kam 33 log mare gaye aur lagbhag 50 ke malbe mein dabey hone ki ashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Yuddh aur manviya sahayata: International exams ke liye — nagrik suraksha aur sahayata kendra.

items.headline: America: Democrats House niyantran ki ore
items.detail: US media ke anumaanon ke mutabik Democrats House mein bahumat ki ore hain, jisse Trump ke agenda ko chunauti mil sakti hai; antim ginati abhi baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — House aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: UN: ICJ ke liye paanch nyayadhish chune
items.detail: General Assembly aur Security Council ne nau saal ke karyakal ke liye paanch nyayadhish chune; unka karyakal 6 February 2027 se shuru hoga.
items.exam_angle: UN aur ICJ: International exams ke liye — ICJ nyayadhish chunav aur karyakal.

items.headline: South Carolina: Andrews ne Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Pediatrician Annie Andrews ne Republican Darline Graham ko harakar 28 saal mein pehli baar Democrats ko South Carolina ki Senate seat dilayi.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Georgia: Bottoms pehli Black mahila governor
items.detail: Keisha Lance Bottoms ne Rick Jackson ko harakar Georgia ki pehli mahila governor banne ka itihas rach diya; ve America mein chuni gayi pehli Black mahila governor hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: Florida: Donalds pehle Black governor bane
items.detail: Republican Byron Donalds ne Democrat David Jolly ko harakar Florida ke pehle Black governor banne ka itihas rach diya; ve DeSantis ki jagah lenge.

items.headline: North Carolina: Cooper ne Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Poorv governor Roy Cooper ne Trump-samarthit Michael Whatley ko harakar Republican ke paas thi seat Democrats ko dilayi; yah Democrats ki pehli seat badli hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Greenland: America raksha samjhauta manzoor
items.detail: Greenland ki sansad ne 16-0 se, saat ke vote na dene ke saath, America-Denmark raksha samjhaute ko manzoori di, jisse do naye American adde ban sakenge; Denmark 19 November ko vote karega.
items.exam_angle: Arctic aur raksha samjhaute: International exams ke liye — Greenland, Denmark aur America.
